title: Erich von Däniken on Templar secrets

tellings.quote:
him about the Templars and he goes there
are secrets that I cannot talk about

plain: When Michels asked Erich von Däniken, the Swiss writer famous for arguing that ancient astronauts visited Earth, about the Templars, the medieval order of knights, von Däniken told him "there are secrets that I cannot talk about." Michels tells this himself, from his own conversation with von Däniken, as a hint that the writer knows more than he will say.
